Name: get_azores_score_for_customer_workloads
Description: Gets the Azores Score for a workload or customer with additional filtering conditions. Please modify the format such that the result is displayed at the top, at the workload name level, instead of at the bottom of the workloads. Additionally, replace the links provided as details with the workload name itself as a hyperlink.

Parameters.Name: workloadIdList
Parameters.Description: List of Workload ID(s) as a dynamic array. The format of Workload identifier is 'ch:customer:{GUID}:id:{GUID}'. Example: dynamic(['ch:customer:xxx:id:yyy', 'ch:customer:aaa:id:bbb']). If this filter is to be used, ALWAYS get the value of workload ID from function get_azores_workload_id_and_name_by_customer_id before proceeding.

Parameters.Name: customerId
Parameters.Description: The Customer ID. Should be the numeric TPID value (e.g., '123456'). If provided in full format 'ch:customer::tpid:123456', extract just the TPID value. ALWAYS get the value of customer ID from function get_customer_id_by_customer_name before proceeding.

Parameters.Name: azoresScoreLowerThreshold
Parameters.Description: The azores score lower bound threshold. Example: if user says 'azores score greater than 10', set this to 10.0. Use real(null) if not specified.

Parameters.Name: azoresScoreUpperThreshold
Parameters.Description: The azores score upper bound threshold. Example: if user says 'azores score less than 20', set this to 20.0. Use real(null) if not specified.

Parameters.Name: zoneResilientResourceCount
Parameters.Description: The number of zone resilient resources to filter by. Use int(null) if not specified.

Parameters.Name: operatorForZoneResilientResourcesCount
Parameters.Description: The comparison operator for zone resilient resource count. Set to '>' if user says 'greater than' or '<' if user says 'less than'. Leave empty if not specified.

Parameters.Name: resourcesCount
Parameters.Description: The total number of resources (sum of zone resilient and non-zone resilient) to filter by. Use int(null) if not specified.

Parameters.Name: operatorForResourcesCount
Parameters.Description: The comparison operator for total resource count. Set to '>' if user says 'greater than' or '<' if user says 'less than'. Leave empty if not specified.

Parameters.Name: topN
Parameters.Description: The number of records to retrieve. Also known as Top 'N'. Defaults to 5 if not provided. Maximum is 50.

List.MessageTemplate:
Here are the Azores Score details for the workloads:
{data}

Name: get_all_workloads_with_azores_score

Parameters.Name: azoresScoreLowerThreshold

Parameters.Name: azoresScoreUpperThreshold
Parameters.Description: The azores score upper bound threshold. Example: if user says 'azores score less than 20', set this to 20.0. Use real(null) if not specified.

Parameters.Name: zoneResilientResourceCount
Parameters.Description: The number of zone resilient resources to filter by. Use int(null) if not specified.

Parameters.Name: operatorForZoneResilientResourcesCount
Parameters.Description: The comparison operator for zone resilient resource count. Set to '>' if user says 'greater than' or '<' if user says 'less than'. Leave empty if not specified.

Parameters.Name: resourcesCount
Parameters.Description: The total number of resources (sum of zone resilient and non-zone resilient) to filter by. Use int(null) if not specified.

Parameters.Name: operatorForResourcesCount
Parameters.Description: The comparison operator for total resource count. Set to '>' if user says 'greater than' or '<' if user says 'less than'. Leave empty if not specified.

Parameters.Name: topN
Parameters.Description: The number of records to retrieve. Also known as Top 'N'. Defaults to 5 if not provided. Maximum is 50.

List.MessageTemplate:
Here are the Azores Score details for all workloads:
{data}

Name: get_resources_for_workload
Description: Gets the Azure resources (zone resilient/non-zone resilient) under a customer workload provided the filtering conditions.

Parameters.Name: workloadId
Parameters.Description: The Workload ID. The format of Workload identifier is 'ch:customer:{GUID}:id:{GUID}'. ALWAYS get the value of workload ID from function get_azores_workload_id_and_name_by_customer_id before proceeding.

Parameters.Name: customerId
Parameters.Description: The Customer ID. Should be the numeric TPID value (e.g., '123456'). ALWAYS get the value of customer ID from function get_customer_id_by_customer_name before proceeding.

Parameters.Name: subscriptionId
Parameters.Description: The Subscription ID in which the customer's resources are present.

Parameters.Name: resourceType
Parameters.Description: The type of resource. For example - Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts, Microsoft.Sql/servers, Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines etc. Search for the resource type in ResourceTypesVectorIndex to get the correct resource type.

Parameters.Name: region
Parameters.Description: The Azure region in which the customer's resources are present. For example - eastus, westus2, westeurope.Search for the region name in AzureRegionsVectorIndex to get the correct region name.

Parameters.Name: isZoneResilient
Parameters.Description: Filter by zone resilient status. Set to true for zone resilient resources, false for non-zone resilient. Use bool(null) if not specified.

Parameters.Name: topN
Parameters.Description: The number of records to retrieve. Also known as Top 'N'. Defaults to 5 if not provided. Maximum is 50.

List.MessageTemplate:
Here are the Azure resources for the workload:
{data}

Name: get_azores_workload_id_and_name_by_customer_id
Description: Gets the Azores Workloads for a customer provided the customer ID. **Use this function ONLY if the user explicitly specifies that they want information in the context of Azores or Zone Resiliency**. All the workloads returned will have workload ID and workload name.

Parameters.Name: customerId
Parameters.Description: The Customer ID. Should be the numeric TPID value (e.g., '123456'). If provided in full format 'ch:customer::tpid:123456', extract just the TPID value. ALWAYS get the value of customer ID from function get_customer_id_by_customer_name before proceeding.

List.MessageTemplate:
Here are the Azores workloads for the customer:
{data}

Name: get_azores_score_by_workload_name
Description: Gets the Azores Workloads and their Azores score provided the workload name. Uses partial matching to find workloads containing the specified name(s).

Parameters.Name: workloadNameList
Parameters.Description: The workload name(s) to search for as a dynamic array. Example: dynamic(['Contoso', 'Fabrikam']). Uses partial matching (has_any) to find workloads containing any of the specified names.

List.MessageTemplate:
Here are the Azores Score details for the matching workloads:
{data}

Name: get_ergw_for_customer
Description: Gets the Express Route Gateways (ERGW or GW or Gateways) for a customer. Types of ERGWs: Multi Homed ERGW, Single Homed ERGW, Zone Resilient ERGW. Returns total gateways, count and percentage of multi-homed and zone resilient gateways for a customer.

Parameters.Name: customerId
Parameters.Description: The Customer ID. Should be the numeric TPID value (e.g., '123456'). ALWAYS get the value of customer ID from function get_customer_id_by_customer_name before proceeding.

Parameters.Name: timePeriod
Parameters.Description: Time period for which user wants to view data. This can be 'week' or 'month'. Defaults to 'week' if not provided.

List.MessageTemplate:
Here are the Express Route Gateway details for the customer:
{data}

Name: get_ergw_for_customer_workloads
Description: Gets the Express Route Gateways (ERGW or GW or Gateways) for workloads with additional filtering conditions. Types of ERGWs: Multi Homed ERGW, Single Homed ERGW, Zone Resilient ERGW. Returns total gateways, count and percentage of multi-homed and zone resilient gateways for workloads.

Parameters.Name: customerId
Parameters.Description: The Customer ID. Should be the numeric TPID value (e.g., '123456'). ALWAYS get the value of customer ID from function get_customer_id_by_customer_name before proceeding.

Parameters.Name: workloadId
Parameters.Description: The Workload ID. ALWAYS get the value of workload ID from function get_expressroute_gateway_workload_from_customer_id before proceeding.

Parameters.Name: timePeriod
Parameters.Description: Time period for which user wants to view data. This can be 'week' or 'month'. Defaults to 'week' if not provided.

Parameters.Name: topN
Parameters.Description: The number of records to retrieve. Also known as Top 'N'. Defaults to 5 if not provided.

List.MessageTemplate:
Here are the Express Route Gateway details for the workloads:
{data}

Name: get_ergw_areas
Description: Gets all the Areas in which Express Route Gateways (ERGW or GW or gateways) are present. Returns list of areas and their express route gateway counts including multi-homed, single homed, mixed and zone resilient gateways.

Parameters.Name: timePeriod
Parameters.Description: Time period for which user wants to view data. This can be 'week' or 'month'. Defaults to 'week' if not provided.

List.MessageTemplate:
Here are the Express Route Gateway areas:
{data}

Name: get_ergw_customer_details_by_area
Description: Gets the list of customers with their Express Route Gateways (ERGW or GW) and their area. Returns area wise list of customers with total gateways, multi-homed and zone resilient gateways.

Parameters.Name: timePeriod
Parameters.Description: Time period for which user wants to view data. This can be 'week' or 'month'. Defaults to 'week' if not provided.

Parameters.Name: areaName
Parameters.Description: Area name for which user wants to see the customers with express route gateways. Leave empty for all areas.

Parameters.Name: programName
Parameters.Description: The program in which the customer is enrolled. ALWAYS check for Program value from user. Defaults to 'S500' if not provided.

Parameters.Name: topN
Parameters.Description: The number of records to retrieve. Also known as Top 'N'. Defaults to 10 if not provided.

List.MessageTemplate:
Here are the customer Express Route Gateway details by area:
{data}

Name: get_expressroute_gateway_workload_from_customer_id
Description: Gets the ExpressRoute Gateways (ERGW) Workloads for a customer provided the customer ID. All the workloads returned will have workload ID and workload name. Returns ERGW Workload Ids and Workload name for a customer.

Parameters.Description: The Customer ID. Should be the numeric TPID value (e.g., '123456'). If provided in full format 'ch:customer::tpid:123456', extract just the TPID value.

List.MessageTemplate:
Here are the ExpressRoute Gateway workloads for the customer:
{data}
